rules.instruction: Use supplied logo files intact; do not redraw, stretch, crop, or recolor them.
Avoid busy imagery behind the logo and preserve the orange-and-grey treatment in the published raster wordmark.

voice.summary: Thoughtful, plain-spoken, practical, and service-oriented. Help church staff and volunteers take the next useful step.
writing_conventions: Use concrete verbs and name constraints plainly.
Write technical detail only when it helps someone act.
Treat church staff and volunteers as capable people with limited time.

rules.instruction: Start with this file for structured brand data and use the supplied logo assets.
Use Signal Orange as an accent and action color, not as long-form body-copy color.
Use Lato at the supplied 400 and 700 weights when the font can be embedded.
Do not invent a tagline, location, full-wordmark SVG, or formal logo measurements.
Do not imply that proposed tokens, logo variants, or semantic mappings are approved brand standards.
Do not use the mark instead of the primary logo where the brand has not already been established.
